description: Find the UK paints closest in colour to a named paint or a hex value, across the 22 brands in the PaintDial library. For a named paint (for example "Hague Blue") it returns the closest colour from each other brand, as shown on that paint's PaintDial page. For a hex value (for example "#2F4858") it returns the closest paints from any brand. Each result has the brand, name, published colour value, a difference score, and a link to its PaintDial page.

brand.description: Optional. With a paint name: the brand it belongs to, if the name is used by more than one brand. With a hex value: only return paints from this brand.

colour.description: A paint name or code (for example "Hague Blue" or "No.30"), or a six-digit hex colour (for example "#2F4858").

limit.description: How many matches to return. Default 5, maximum 10.

name: find_closest_paints
title: Find the closest paints
